0022600221.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-4, 3-2 on the road) are 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West, 2.5 games back, and enter on a one-game losing streak, while the Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, 5-0 on the road) are 3rd in the Southwest and 6th in the West, 1 game back, on a one-game winning streak. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), with Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Quinten Post (head) both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-119 regular-season win in Denver on April 8, 2026.
